name: Kanda Tsushinki Co., Ltd.
summary: Kanda Tsushinki Co.,Ltd. provides construction contract services in Japan. It is also involved in the information and communication systems development, software development, control lighting, communication system development, and computer network system development businesses. In addition, the company manufactures, maintains, and sells computer, OA, and communication equipment and supplies. Further, it engages in facility service and contact center businesses. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
